newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat pre-bourse prices indicate rise.
newsitem.headline: Fiat pre-bourse prices indicate rise.

text.p: Shares in Italian carmaker Fiat gained sharply in pre-bourse pricing following news the government planned incentives to encourage people to scrap old cars and buy new ones, traders said.
Stock market prices indicated Fiat shares at 4,700 lire against Monday's close of 4,351, which if the stock starts at this level would give it an opening rise of about eight percent.
The cabinet approved measures late on Monday to encourage people owning cars of 10 years or more to scrap the vehicle and buy a new one.

The government intends to introduce a contribution for nine months for the purchase of cars linked to the scrapping old ones, which will be paid in the form of a discount which producers will make to the client.
